card: Delta SkyMiles Gold American Express Card
notes: $0 intro annual fee first year, then $150. New in 2026: second checked bag free on domestic Delta flights and a $10/month rideshare credit (after first renewal, enrollment required).

entitlements.name: First-year annual fee waived
entitlements.limits: Annual fee is $0 for the first year of membership, then $150 per year.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Annual Fee : $0 introductory annual fee for the first year, then $150.

entitlements.name: 2X miles on Delta purchases
entitlements.source_excerpt: 2X MILES On Delta Purchases Made directly with Delta.

entitlements.name: 2X miles on dining
entitlements.limits: Restaurants worldwide; takeout and delivery only in the U.S.
entitlements.source_excerpt: 2X MILES On Dining At restaurants, including takeout and delivery in the U.S.

entitlements.name: 2X miles at U.S. supermarkets
entitlements.source_excerpt: 2X MILES On Groceries At U.S. supermarkets.

entitlements.name: 1X miles on other purchases
entitlements.source_excerpt: 1X MILES Per Dollar On Other Purchases.

entitlements.name: $200 Delta Flight Credit after $10K spend
entitlements.limits: Earned after $10,000 in eligible purchases in a calendar year; issued as a Delta Flight Credit for future travel, not cash. Expiry window of the issued credit not confirmed on issuer page.
entitlements.source_excerpt: After you spend $10,000 in eligible purchases on your Card in a calendar year, you can receive a $200 Delta Flight Credit to use toward future travel.

entitlements.name: Delta Stays credit

trigger.channel: prepaid booking through Delta Stays on delta.com

entitlements.limits: Up to $100 back per year as a statement credit on prepaid hotels or vacation rentals. Issuer pages say 'per year'/'annually'; calendar-year vs card-year reset not stated on the pages checked.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Get up to $100 back per year as a statement credit after using your Delta SkyMiles Gold American Express Card to book prepaid hotels or vacation rentals through Delta Stays on delta.com.

entitlements.name: Rideshare credit

trigger.channel: U.S. rideshare purchases with select providers

entitlements.limits: Up to $10 per month ($120/yr), starting only after the first card renewal. Eligible providers not named on the pages checked.
entitlements.source_excerpt: After your first Card renewal, earn up to $10 in statement credits each month when using your Delta SkyMiles Gold American Express Card on U.S. rideshare purchases with select providers.

entitlements.name: First checked bag free
entitlements.limits: Delta flights worldwide. Eligibility details (linked SkyMiles number, companions on reservation) are in benefit terms not reviewed.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Enjoy your first checked bag free on Delta flights worldwide

entitlements.name: Second checked bag free (domestic)
entitlements.limits: Domestic Delta flights only. Marked NEW on the issuer page.
entitlements.source_excerpt: and on domestic Delta flights, your second bag flies free too.

entitlements.name: Zone 5 Priority Boarding
entitlements.source_excerpt: Receive Zone 5 Priority Boarding on Delta flights; board early, stow your carry-on bag and settle in sooner.

entitlements.name: 20% back on in-flight purchases
entitlements.limits: Statement credit on eligible in-flight food and beverage purchases only.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Receive a 20% savings in the form of a statement credit after you use your Delta SkyMiles Gold American Express Card on eligible Delta in-flight purchases of food and beverages.

entitlements.name: TakeOff 15 award discount
entitlements.limits: 15% fewer miles on Delta award flights; not for partner-operated flights or taxes and fees.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Take 15% off anytime you book Award Travel with miles on Delta flights when using delta.com and the Fly Delta app.

entitlements.name: Pay with Miles
entitlements.limits: Up to $50 off a flight per 5,000 miles redeemed.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Take up to $50 off the cost of your flight for every 5,000 miles you redeem with Pay with Miles when you book on delta.com.

entitlements.name: No foreign transaction fees
entitlements.source_excerpt: Enjoy international travel without additional fees on purchases made abroad.

entitlements.name: Baggage Insurance Plan
entitlements.limits: Entire common-carrier fare must be on the card. Up to $1,250 carry-on and $500 checked, in excess of carrier coverage; NY residents $10,000 aggregate per trip.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Coverage can be provided for up to $1,250 for carry-on Baggage and up to $500 for checked Baggage, in excess of coverage provided by the Common Carrier.

entitlements.name: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
entitlements.limits: Secondary coverage, no liability. Reserve and pay the entire rental on the card and decline the CDW. Not available in Australia, Italy, New Zealand; some vehicle types excluded.
entitlements.source_excerpt: This product provides secondary coverage and does not include liability coverage.

entitlements.name: Global Assist Hotline
entitlements.limits: 24/7 coordination and referrals; cardholder pays third-party provider costs.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Whenever you travel more than 100 miles from home, Global Assist Hotline is available for 24/7 emergency assistance and coordination services

entitlements.name: Purchase Protection
entitlements.limits: Theft or accidental damage within 90 days of purchase; up to $1,000 per covered purchase, $50,000 per calendar year.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Up to $1,000 per Covered Purchase, up to $50,000 per calendar year.

entitlements.name: Extended Warranty
entitlements.limits: Adds up to 1 year to original manufacturer warranties of 5 years or less; U.S. and territories purchases.
entitlements.source_excerpt: you can get up to one extra year added to the Original Manufacturer's Warranty. Applies to warranties of 5 years or less

entitlements.name: Amex Venue Collection concessions 10% back
entitlements.limits: Qualifying concessions at participating venues; up to $250 back per calendar year; one enrolled card per member.
entitlements.source_excerpt: eligible Card Members can enroll their Card and get 10% back on qualifying concessions purchases at venues/arenas/stadiums in the American Express Venue collection, up to $250 per calendar year.
